features.title: Battlerager Vigor
features.description:
Whenever you hit an enemy with a melee or a close attack, you gain temporary hit points equal to your *Constitution*, plus any temporary hit points normally granted by the power. You gain the hit points only after the attack is resolved.

If you use an invigorating Fighter attack power and miss every target with it, you gain temporary hit points equal to your *Constitution*. When wearing light armor or chainmail, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with melee and close weapon attacks whenever you have temporary hit points.
